title: Wind Farm Maintenance Plan - Synthetic Inspection Group 2017-2018
markdown:
# Wind Farm Maintenance Plan

> **Note on farm data:** The farm is synthetic — an invented grouping of real drone photos. Years labeled 2017 / 2018 are synthetic groupings for comparison, not continuous monitoring of the same physical condition. Trends compare defect counts and verified severities between groupings, not photo-to-photo change.

## 1. Deterministic Priority Ranking (from `list_turbines`, not re-ranked)

Ranking is by deterministic priority score of **verified** defects (`verdict=ok` only):

1. **T02** — rank 1, score 9.0, status `needs_review`, trend **worse** — max verified severity 3; 5 defects; 2 need review. Compare: 2017 verified severities [1] → 2018 [3,3,2].
2. **T01** — rank 2, score 5.5, status `needs_review`, trend **better** — max verified severity 3; 8 defects; 7 need review. Compare: 2017 verified [3,3,2] → 2018 [3]; synthetic years note applies.
3. **T06** — rank 3, score 2.5, status `needs_review`, trend **worse** — no verified defect; 3 defects; 3 need review. Compare: 2017 [ ] → 2018 [ ].
4. **T10** — rank 4, score 1.25, status `needs_review`, trend **worse** — no verified defect; 6 defects; 5 need review + 1 need new photos. Compare: 2017 [ ] → 2018 [ ].
5. **T07** — rank 5, score 1.0, status `needs_review`, trend **better** — max verified severity 1; 4 defects; 3 need review. Compare: 2017 [3,1,1] → 2018 [1].
6. **T04** — rank 6, score 0.25, status `needs_review`, trend **same** — no verified defect; 1 defect; 1 need review. Compare: 2017 [ ] → 2018 [ ].

Only the 6 highest-ranked turbines were processed per limits.

## 2. Work Orders — Verified Defects Only

Priority mapping: severity 4-5 → P1 repair, 3 → P2 repair, 2 → P3 monitor, 1 → no order.

### T02-2018 (inspection T02-2018, 4 images, 5 defects)
- **WO-001 — P2 Repair** — inspection_id T02-2018 — defects `T02-2018/DJI_0711_01_04/d1` (surface_damage, severity 3, verdict ok, agreement 1.0, confidence 0.33) and `T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d1` (surface_damage, severity 3, verdict ok, agreement 1.0, confidence 0.58) — Action: Schedule blade surface_damage repair for verified severity 3 defects — Rationale: both looks agree on severity 3, all rule checks passed — Due: 30 days
- **WO-002 — P3 Monitor** — inspection_id T02-2018 — defect `T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d5` (surface_damage, severity 2, verdict ok, agreement 1.0, confidence 0.33) — Action: Monitor surface_damage progression — Rationale: verified ok severity 2 per rubric — Due: 90 days

### T01-2018 (inspection T01-2018, 4 images, 8 defects)
- **WO-003 — P2 Repair** — inspection_id T01-2018 — defect `T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d2` (crack, severity 3, verdict ok, agreement 1.0, confidence 0.32) — Action: Schedule crack repair for verified severity 3 defect — Rationale: both looks agree on severity 3 — Due: 30 days

### T07-2018
- No work order for verified severity 1 defect `T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d6` (dirt, severity 1, verdict ok) — per rules severity 1 needs no order.

No verified severity 4-5 defects found among top 6 turbines, so no P1 orders. All other defects cited had `needs_review` / `reinspect` and were not used for repair/monitor.

## 3. Re-inspections Requested (low confidence — new photos required, never guessed)

- **WO-004** — T02-2018 — defects `T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d2`, `T02-2018/DJI_0982_06_05/d6` — Reason: verdict needs_review, combined confidence 0.25/0.28 below 0.3, severity disagreement — Action: Capture higher-resolution blade surface photos in better lighting
- **WO-005** — T01-2018 — defects `T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d4`, `T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d6`, `T01-2018/DJI_0681_06_09/d7`, `T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d1`, `T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d2`, `T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d3`, `T01-2018/DJI_0391_06_05/d4` — Reason: all needs_review with low confidence / rule failures (detector_score, severity_vs_size) — Action: Re-photograph blade sections with stable exposure and closer distance
- **WO-006** — T06-2018 — defects `T06-2018/DJI_0785_03_02/d1`, `T06-2018/DJI_0609_05_05/d1`, `T06-2018/DJI_0609_05_05/d2` — Reason: needs_review, combined confidence 0.20 below 0.3, severity disagreement — Action: Capture new high-resolution images of indicated blade areas
- **WO-007** — T10-2018 — defects `T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d2`, `T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d3`, `T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d4` (reinspect), `T10-2018/DJI_0351_03_03/d6`, `T10-2018/DJI_0682_06_05/d1`, `T10-2018/DJI_0682_06_05/d2` — Reason: needs_review/reinspect with low confidence 0.15, 3-level severity disagreement, detector_score and severity_vs_size failures — Action: Re-inspect with closer, well-lit photos
- **WO-008** — T07-2018 — defects `T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d1`, `T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d3`, `T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d7` — Reason: needs_review with severity disagreement and confidence 0.25 below threshold — Action: Obtain clearer photos of blade tip and trailing edge areas
- **WO-009** — T04-2018 — defect `T04-2018/DJI_0005_07_04/d1` — Reason: needs_review, detector_score 0.07 and severity_vs_size failure (severity 2 covers 11.4% of photo) — Action: Re-photograph leading edge erosion area with calibrated distance

## 4. Limits and Evidence

- Planning used ONLY tool outputs; no drone photos were viewed. No defect, severity, or trend was stated beyond what `get_inspection` / `compare_inspections` / `list_turbines` returned, with defect ids cited.
- Work orders created only for `verdict=ok` defects; all `needs_review`/`reinspect` routed to re-inspection, never guessed.
- Scope limited to top 6 ranked turbines (T02, T01, T06, T10, T07, T04). Turbines T08-T12 not processed in this cycle.
- Synthetic grouping caveat: compare 2017 vs 2018 as count/severity comparison, not literal deterioration. T02 shows verified escalation 1→3, while T07 shows verified improvement 3→1 within synthetic grouping.
- Severity 1 verified defect (`T07-2018/DJI_0682_07_06/d6`) correctly received no order per rule.
